facts.fact: The IFAD PRIME Africa end-of-project profile (April 2026) says 184,000 people in The Gambia received remittances into APS wallets from European Union corridors (France, Germany, Italy, Norway, Spain, Sweden).
The IFAD PRIME Africa end-of-project profile (April 2026) reports US$135 million in remittances received digitally through APS and an average APS remittance cost of 5 per cent across PRIME corridors.
